features.name: Claude API Backend
features.description: Secure integration with Anthropic API for AI-powered productivity features. Foundation for Smart Productivity Assistant suite.
verification: API key never exposed to frontend (server-side only)
POST /api/ai/complete endpoint accepts prompts and returns responses
Rate limiting prevents abuse (10 requests/minute per client)
Error handling for API failures (timeouts, rate limits, invalid keys)
Usage logged to SQLite (tracking tokens, timestamps)

steps.description: Add ai_usage table to SQLite schema for tracking API calls
steps.details: CREATE TABLE ai_usage with columns: id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, model, endpoint, client_ip, created_at
Initialize Anthropic client with env var, create completion function with error handling
In-memory rate limiter (10 req/min per IP), using Map with sliding window
POST /api/ai/complete - validates input, applies rate limit, calls Anthropic, logs usage

steps.description: Mount AI routes in main server

risks: API key exposure if not handled correctly
Rate limiting may need tuning for production
Token costs if no usage limits enforced
mitigations: API key only loaded on server, never sent to client
Rate limiting at 10 req/min is conservative for development
plan.approachFromSuccesses: Used better-sqlite3 for synchronous DB operations. Created separate route files for each resource. Implemented validation utilities and custom error classes.

features.name: Natural Language Task Entry
features.description: Parse natural language into structured tasks using Claude AI. Example: 'Buy groceries tomorrow morning' becomes a task with title, due date, and priority.
verification: Natural language input field visible in Tasks widget
Parses dates correctly (today, tomorrow, next week, specific dates)
Extracts priority from urgency words (urgent, important, low priority)
Shows loading animation during AI processing

steps.description: Add POST /api/ai/parse-task endpoint to parse natural language into structured task
steps.details: Use Claude to parse text like 'Buy groceries tomorrow morning' into {title, priority, dueDate}. Returns JSON with structured task fields.

steps.description: Create AI API client for frontend
steps.details: Export aiApi with parseTask() method that calls /api/ai/parse-task and returns ParsedTask type
Input field with sparkle/wand icon, loading spinner during AI processing, error state, submit on Enter. Crystalline Noir styling.
Add NL input above Add Task button. On parsed result, auto-populate modal or directly create task. Fallback: if AI fails, show manual modal.

risks: AI response parsing failures if Claude returns unexpected format
mitigations: Structured JSON schema in system prompt with example output
Loading state with animated spinner, async operation
Graceful fallback to manual entry modal on any error
plan.approachFromSuccesses: Used existing api/index.ts pattern for client API. Reuse Button and motion/react animations. Follow TasksWidget patterns.
